buildCommand: cd app && npm install && npm run build
ignoreCommand: [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- . ':(exclude)data-idx' ':(exclude)arus-pasar' ':(exclude)docs' && exit 0 || exit 1
